author: Rajiv Arokiaraj
content:
Hi Ankit,

I found your article very interesting. I am in a similar situation as you and trying to replace veracode tool within my organization. I wanted to under your experience with Kiuwan. I presume you have been using it for the past year or more. Please share your feedback. I would be very helpful for me.

Regards,
Rajiv

author: Ankit Vijay
content: Hi Rajiv, Glad that you like the article. Our experience with Kiuwan has only been positive. They are not a massive organization like Veracode, and they have a good product. They are also very prompt to respond to the feedback. While what is right for your organization depends on your organizational needs but for a mid-size organization like ours, Kiuwan fits the bill perfectly.
